issue.title: Make the install_ui EarnedEta test hermetic to CARGO_INCREMENTAL
issue.description: lint-incremental: fix the one deterministic lint-job failure. In the check-scripts step, EarnedEtaTests.test_seeded_history_shows_bar_range_plan_and_summary seeds history rows with incremental=True, but CI's rust-cache sets CARGO_INCREMENTAL=0, so no row matches and the "usually" ETA text never renders. Make the test independent of the caller's CARGO_INCREMENTAL, then prove it with and without the variable.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/bob_cli_ci_green.md defines phase lint-incremental as one work unit

issue.title: Fix the known macOS-only test failures and the Google sign-in hang
issue.description: mac-known-failures: on the mac host, reproduce and fix the macOS-only failures already seen in CI. Lib: one case-insensitive-APFS test and three /var vs /private/var path tests. CLI: clipboard_status picking Alfred over the command provider. gcal_auth: 11 login tests each stall about 600 s because choose_flow picks the browser flow on macOS, so the paste-scripted tests wait out CONSENT_WINDOW. Make every Google login test family (gcal_auth, gmail_shell, and gkeep_auth if affected) select its flow deterministically on every OS.
issue.creation_reason: Epic plan plan:202611/bob_cli_ci_green.md defines phase mac-known-failures as one work unit

issue.title: Run the full macOS CI test set to green on the mac host
issue.description: mac-full-suite: on a tree that contains the mac-known-failures fixes, run every command CI's macOS job runs on the mac host, with a per-binary watchdog. Every test binary after gcal_auth (all gmail_* suites, gcal_*, gkeep_*, randomize, tasks_parity, tasks_real_vault_parity, doctests) has not run on macOS since about 2026-11-02. Fix every remaining failure or hang, and show that the macOS test step fits well inside its unchanged 45-minute job timeout.
